messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hey there! I actually need a bit of help with an order, but I’m not sure if I’m in the right place. I have this T-shirt that I want to swap out, but I also have a gift card, and I’m not sure how that all works together. Can you help me figure this out?

Yes—I can help with that. To make any changes to an order (like an exchange), I first need to authenticate your account.

Please reply with **one** of the following:

1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **Your first name, last name, and ZIP code**

Also, if you can, share your **order ID** (it looks like `#W0000000`).  
Once I have that, I can check whether the order is **pending or delivered** and explain exactly how using your **gift card** would apply to the swap (including whether it would cover any price difference).

Oh, okay! So, I think my email is amelia.gonzalez4271@example.com. And I do have an order number somewhere... I believe it’s #W7209932? I’m not sure if you need my ZIP code too, but let me know! Also, I’m not sure if the shirt has been delivered or not—I got a package, but I get a lot of packages, so it’s hard to keep track. Does that help?

### How the gift card works for an exchange
For **delivered exchanges**, you provide a **payment method** to cover any **price difference** (or receive a refund if the replacement costs less). If you choose a **gift card** as the payment method, the gift card is used for/credited immediately for the difference.

### Next step (need your confirmation)
To exchange the **T-shirt**, I’ll need:
1) The **new T-shirt item/option** you want (color/size/style/material), *or* you can tell me the exact preferences and I’ll help you pick available options.
2) Confirmation that you want to exchange **only the T-shirt** (item id **5047954489**)—not the backpack.
3) Which **payment method** to use for the difference (gift card is fine).  

Reply with what new T-shirt you want, and confirm “**exchange only the T-shirt**.”

Okay, so I definitely want to exchange just the T-shirt, not the backpack—unless you think the backpack would look better in red too? Just kidding! For the T-shirt, I want to switch it to a red, XXL, cotton, crew neck one. I hope that’s clear, but let me know if you need more details, because sometimes I get confused with all the options.

And yes, please use my gift card for any price difference, or refund it back to the gift card if it’s cheaper. Is there anything else you need from me? Or do I need to send the blue one back first, or do you send the red one before I return it?
